description:
Synthesize L, Pi, T, or ladder matching networks for broadband impedance transformation.
Inputs: Units, ranges and defaults are in each parameter's schema; one left out takes its default. Takes up to 2 .s2p file(s) via inputFiles (inline) or inputPaths (local paths); the server uploads them. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Cross-parameter checks: sweep_stop_after_start. Time budget 120 s; waitSeconds (default 90, max 600) bounds the wait.
Example: {"sourceR":50,"sourceX":0,"loadR":200,"loadX":0,"freqStart":800000000,"freqStop":1200000000}
Returns: The chosen topology and its component values, snapped to the requested series and ideal, the worst-case return loss in the band and whether the target was met, the achieved bandwidth and Q, and the S11 and Smith-chart trajectory described as series. Also warnings, provenance and the result page link; series are described, not listed (full: true returns everything). If waitSeconds runs out first: the jobId and progress, and the job keeps running.
Runs as a job on rftools.io and counts against the monthly run allowance (free lane without a key).

componentSeries.description: Component Series. Standard values every element is snapped to before the headline return loss is computed. E24 is what the tool has always used. omit for the default of "E24"

freqStart.description: Freq Start (Hz). Lower bound of matching band. min 1000. omit for the default of 800000000

freqStop.description: Freq Stop (Hz). min 1000. omit for the default of 1200000000

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

inputFiles.description: Optional. 0–2 file(s), .s2p. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Inline content; at most 5 MB in one call. The server uploads them and passes the keys.

name.description: File name including its extension, e.g. "channel.s4p"

inputPaths.description: Optional. 0–2 file(s), .s2p. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Paths on this machine, read by the server and uploaded.

loadR.description: Load Resistance (Ω). min 0.1. omit for the default of 200

loadX.description: Load Reactance (Ω). omit for the default of 0

maxQ.description: Max Q Factor. Upper bound on each section's loaded Q; omit for unconstrained. Ladder networks are measured against the ceiling but not constrained by it. min 0.1

sourceFileRole.description: Touchstone File Role. What an uploaded .s2p describes. Ignored when no file is uploaded. omit for the default of "none". Advanced — most callers can leave it out

sourceR.description: Source Resistance (Ω). Real part of source impedance. min 0.1. omit for the default of 50

sourceX.description: Source Reactance (Ω). Imaginary part of source impedance. omit for the default of 0

targetRL.description: Target Return Loss (dB). Return loss the synthesiser aims for across the band; a negative number of dB. min -60, max 0. omit for the default of -15. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

topology.description: Topology. omit for the default of "L"

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

name: simulate_impedance_matching
title: Broadband Impedance Matching Synthesizer
